reason: 该插件主要面向界面定制用途，用于在 DeepSeek Harness Web 的空会话 Hero 区域替换标题文案并调整样式与颜色，同时可基于当前背景自动联动生成文本渐变，属于偏界面美化与布局展示增强类扩展。

summaries.zh: 这是一个用于 DeepSeek Harness Web 的客户端插件，可自定义空会话 Hero 标题文案并样式化展示，并可依据当前背景色自动调整标题渐变色。
summaries.en: This is a client-side plugin for DeepSeek Harness Web that customizes the empty-state hero headline text and styling, with optional automatic gradient color adaptation from the current background.

capabilities: Client-side DOM replacement of DeepSeek Harness empty-state hero headline text and related badge visibility.
Dynamic visual styling for hero text (gradient text, stroke/glow effects) and recoloring of a hero icon via DOM/CSS changes.
Palette extraction from background image/video output in the browser to generate headline gradient colors with fallback behavior.

reasons.code: README explicitly states it is a client-only plugin that replaces the empty-state hero headline and hides the adjacent preview badge via MutationObserver-based DOM handling.
README describes auto-picking background colors (from image/video sources) via canvas median-cut clustering to generate the text gradient, with fallback when unavailable.
package.json declares DSH web-client bundle with immediate client injection, confirming the plugin’s runtime scope in the web UI.
